desc: Derive and verify edge-contribution coefficients for k=v, u<k<v, k=u, 2<=k<u, and u=1.
Implement direct edge-contribution O(1) query solution with modular inverses, factorial, prefix sums, and efficient IO.
Run sample tests and small brute-force random validation; if coefficients fail, switch to expected-depth/LCA or offline recurrence approach.
